citation: Descendants of George and Elizabeth Hobson, Jesse Hobson entry
locator: Jesse Hobson biographical entry: move to Naperville area ca. 1830 and 6 Apr 1835 marriage
note: Retrospective genealogy used only as a candidate-identity lead for T-0482. It places an exact-name Jesse Hobson near Chicago/Naperville before and during 1835 and gives a Cook-area chronology, but it is not a contemporary primary source and does not by itself prove that the Chicago post-office letter-list entry is the same man.
